what: Emergency transfer coordination: simulation grounded in real data

param_registry.name: transfer_rate
param_registry.source: Share of ED visits that become an emergency transfer request needing ICU-level or specialty care. Anchor: 1.5% of all US ED encounters end in transfer to another acute hospital (Kindermann et al., Acad Emerg Med 2015, HCUP NEDS 2009; 3.0% for rural patients). Not every transfer needs critical care, so 1.0% is the centre and 0.5%/1.5% the sweep.

param_registry.name: los_icu_days
param_registry.source: Mean ICU stay of 34,696 Medicare ICU survivors, 3.4 days (Moitra et al., Crit Care Med 2016, PMID 26571190; 2005 data).

param_registry.name: call_min
param_registry.source: Minutes per phone call to a hospital (reach the right person, present the patient, get an answer). Anchor: a regional ED needed a mean 4.7 calls and 56.7 min to get a transfer accepted (~12 min per call; Monash University study, 2003). Swept 5-15.

param_registry.name: bid_window_min
param_registry.source: Minutes MAHROS waits for hospitals to answer the call-for-bids (the bed board answers at once; a charge nurse confirms). Swept 1-5.

param_registry.name: icu_vent_share
param_registry.source: Share of ICU patients on a ventilator (used for ventilator availability).

param_registry.name: vents_per_icu_bed
param_registry.source: Ventilators per staffed ICU bed (no public per-hospital data; same as the entered equipment seed).

param_registry.name: nurse_ratio_icu
param_registry.source: ICU patients per registered nurse: California Code of Regulations, Title 22, §70217 (1:2).

param_registry.name: short_staff_cut
param_registry.source: Share of ICU nurses missing at a hospital that is short-staffed this week. WHICH hospitals are short is drawn with the REAL state share of hospitals reporting a critical staffing shortage that week (HHS g62h-syeh).

param_registry.name: reserve_beds
param_registry.source: ICU beds a hospital keeps back for its own emergency department (hospitals with >= 10 ICU beds). Hospital policy, private to each hospital agent.

param_registry.name: cath_day_util
param_registry.source: Share of daytime (07-19 h) a cath-lab room is busy with other procedures.

param_registry.name: cath_callin_min
param_registry.source: Minutes to bring the on-call cath team in at night.

param_registry.name: surgery_ready_min
param_registry.source: Minutes for a trauma / neurosurgery / burns team to be ready once accepted.

param_registry.name: window_scale
param_registry.source: Multiplier on every clinical window below.

calibration.note: Calibration, not validation: arrival rates are solved so the expected capped census equals each hospital's REPORTED weekly average.
